d:
Turn the volume up — the stage is about to catch fire
Get ready to experience the electrifying energy of “Athray” from the album Shaa Ra Ra Ra. Packed with infectious beats, punchy rhythms, and unstoppable Punjabi pop energy, this track is built to ignite live stages and keep the crowd moving.
Performed and composed by Daler Mehndi, this track is a reminder of why his sound continues to command stages across generations.
Plug in. Turn it up. Let the rhythm take over.
